content.text:
Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Moneo issue #227: configurable speech-to-text for the CHAT MIC only. Voice calls stay untouched. PR 1 (#267, engine contract, batch route, fallback, Settings → Voice → Speech to text) and PR 2 (#282, the "On this computer" local engine) are merged; read that code first. You build **PR 3: the OpenRouter engine.**

**Engine**
- The owner picks an OpenRouter model that accepts audio input. Build the dropdown from OpenRouter's models API, filtered to `input_modalities` that include audio. Use the owner's existing OpenRouter key (`openrouter_api_key` through lib/service-keys and lib/ai/keys).
- On Send/Done, the batch route sends the recording (WAV or base64 `input_audio`) with a short instruction to return a plain transcript only. Pass the vocabulary hints from `lib/ai/speech/hints.ts`.
- No OpenRouter key, or an empty model list: the option shows why it can't be used.
- The existing fallback rule applies: if OpenRouter fails and an OpenAI key exists, use OpenAI and show the note.

**Settings**
- Make "OpenRouter" selectable in the Speech to text section (it currently shows "coming soon").
- Store the chosen model like the other speech settings. Reset all data clears it.
- If you need a migration, give it a unique prefix later than the newest file in supabase/migrations on origin/main, keep lib/schema.ts aligned, and make sure it runs on the desktop's Postgres.

**Docs:** README.md.

**Tests:** mock OpenRouter fetch. Cover engine selection, the request shape, fallback, and model-list filtering. No real calls.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 227 --comments`.
- Branch `t3/issue-227-openrouter-engine` from current `origin/main`. Commit each step, ending each message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Don't end your turn while a command or CI run is still going.** Wait in the same turn.
- **Never kill a process you didn't start yourself in this session, verified by PID.**
- Run one `npm ci` at a time. If it stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- The QA app on port 3100 and the moneo-qa backend are shared:
  - never `npm run qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`;
  - never touch the owner's backend;
  - revert any migration you apply to QA.
- **Run `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` yourself and quote their last lines in your final reply.** Also run `npm test` and `npm run build`.
- Run the verify-ui skill on Settings (light/dark/mobile). Link the screenshots in the PR body from a commit, then remove them from the branch.
- Push and open a PR to `main`. The body says "Part 3 of #227" (don't close the issue) and ends with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

The build takes a few minutes the first time. Then open **http://localhost:3000**.

#### 5. Turn on the AI

Go to **Settings → Keys and connections → AI access** and choose one:

- **Sign in with ChatGPT** to use your ChatGPT Go, Plus or Pro plan,
- **Sign in with Claude** to use your Claude Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise plan (see [Use your Claude plan](#use-your-claude-plan-optional)), or
- **Paste an OpenAI API key** ([create one here](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)) and click **Save key**. Usage is billed to that key.

In Settings ? AI and your data, type or choose one default model for all AI tasks (GPT-6 Luna by default with OpenAI). Turn on ?Customize by task? for individual overrides; turning it off clears those overrides when you save. Model IDs are saved without a provider call, so unavailable models report an error when used. Claude-only installs use a Claude default.

Voice calls need the OpenAI API key. Settings → Voice chooses the speech-to-text engine for the chat microphone: OpenAI, or **On this computer**, which needs no key (see [Speech to text on this computer](#speech-to-text-on-this-computer-optional)). OpenAI is also the fallback when a chosen engine can't run. An OpenRouter key is optional (for other models).

#### 6. Add your money

- **Import** a CSV or Excel export from your bank, or
- connect your bank or Scalable Capital (optional, see below).

That's it. Want it on your phone or tablet too? See [Use it from your phone or tablet](#use-it-from-your-phone-or-tablet-optional).

Chat, artifacts, briefings, imports and the agents then run on Claude (Opus 5.5 for the chat, Haiku 5.5 for lighter tasks; change them under **Settings → AI and your data → Advanced**). Requests count toward your plan's usage limits, shown at [claude.ai/settings/usage](https://claude.ai/settings/usage).

- **Never billed to an API key.** Moneo removes `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and similar settings before it starts Claude Code, and only runs Claude when Claude Code is signed in with a Claude plan. If you sign out of Claude Code, AI stays off until you sign in again or pick another option.
- **Only Moneo's tools.** Claude gets Moneo's finance tools and nothing else: no files, no shell, no other MCP servers, and no chat history saved by Claude Code. Changes still go through cards you accept.
- **Not yet:** voice calls, which still need an OpenAI API key for the audio. Dictation works with an OpenAI key or [on this computer](#speech-to-text-on-this-computer-optional).
- **Stop using Claude** switches Moneo back to ChatGPT or your API key. It doesn't sign you out of Claude Code.
- Anthropic's rules say apps may not offer Claude plan sign-in without its approval ([Agent SDK overview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview)). Moneo only uses the Claude Code login you set up yourself, on your own computer. Decide for yourself whether that fits your use.

### Speech to text on this computer (optional)

The chat microphone can turn speech into text on the computer that runs Moneo, so recordings never leave it. It works from your phone too, because the model runs on the computer.

1. In **Settings → Voice**, set **Speech to text** to **On this computer**.
2. Click **Download** next to a model. Moonshine Base (67 MB) and Distil-Whisper (175 MB) understand English; Whisper Base (80 MB) and Whisper Small (252 MB) understand many languages, including German. Moonshine is the fastest, Whisper Small the most accurate. Models are saved in `.data/speech-models` (in the desktop app, in its data folder) and downloaded once from Hugging Face; each file is checked against its known size and hash, and a stopped download continues where it left off.
3. Or choose **A model you already have**: a folder holding a Whisper or Moonshine model in ONNX format (`config.json`, the tokenizer files and an `onnx` folder), such as one from [onnx-community](https://huggingface.co/onnx-community). Type its full path, or click **Choose folder…** in the desktop app.
4. Click **Try it**, say a sentence and check the text, then **Save preferences**.

The model loads the first time you use the mic and is unloaded after five idle minutes. Moneo passes the names of your accounts, shops and categories to Whisper models so they spell them right. Intel Macs can't run these models yet. If the model is missing or fails, Moneo uses OpenAI when you have added a key, and says so. Downloaded models aren't part of backups and stay when you reset your data; delete the folder to remove them.

### Connect your bank (optional)

Moneo syncs booked transactions and balances from EU banks (for example Revolut and Commerzbank) through [Enable Banking](https://enablebanking.com). It is free for personal use. Each sync is an ordinary import that you can review and undo. Moneo also keeps what the bank sent for each transaction (codes, counterparty details, references) on your computer to help organize it; undoing a sync removes it.
